number: 106
title: Share task scoring and slim the task interface
milestone: M2.5
labels:
  - kind: refactor
  - area: tasks
parent: m2.5-p4-one-search-framework
---

Balanced accuracy is written in `AcceptorTask`, `StreamingTask` and `SpikeWordTask`; "share of runs right per check" in `SequenceTask`, `SpikeWordTask` and `StreamingTask`; prefix counting twice; `FunctionTask` scores each case twice; `ProgramSearch` rebuilds `GeneratorTask`'s score; `ContractTask` (271 lines) finds done ports twice and mixes scoring, port reading, behaviour keys and proposals; and `ITask` carries `Focus`, `Triggered` and `Propose`, so callers downcast (`CompositionSpace.For`, `PartProposals`, `Benchmark`, `CurriculumPlan`).
We want shared scoring helpers, `ITask` holding only what every task has, the optional abilities as separate interfaces, and no type checks on concrete tasks outside the tasks themselves.

Its responsibilities are:
* Scoring helpers: balanced accuracy, per-check share, correct prefix
* `ContractTask` split into the scorer, the port reader and the behaviour key
* `ITask` slimmed; focus, triggering and proposing as interfaces a task may implement
* Callers asking for an ability rather than a concrete type
* Two input encodings joined: `InputSpikes.Numbers` and `PortEncoding.Interval` are the same encoding
* Median written once, in `Statistics`

Scores should be identical for every task in the suite, checked against the golden runs, because the scoring rules are what the benchmarks report.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Tasks/`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Modules/CompositionSearch.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Proposals/PartProposals.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Benchmarking/`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/IterativeEvolution.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/InputSpikes.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Operators/LexicaseSelection.cs`.

Done when:
- [ ] Each scoring rule has one definition and `ContractTask`'s parts are each under 300 lines
- [ ] No `is SequenceTask`, `is ContractTask` or similar check outside `Tasks/`
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged; `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "Tasks", "Checks, lexicase selection and modules"
